# MATCH-PENDING functions

Every function in `build/units.json` compiles to the game's bytes. A function counts as **matched under the rules** only when it also passes every [match] rule (`AGENTS.md`, "The two laws"); the others are listed here as `MATCH-PENDING`, with the rules they fail. Their source is kept: it is the best-known state, and it still matches byte for byte. `UNLOCATED` functions are compiler-generated (adjustor thunks, deleting destructors) and have no source lines to check.

Generated by `f3ledger` from the rule checker `f3rules` (branch `campaign-tools`) at commit `439ccd9`. Do not edit by hand; regenerate it.
